branch_contract.scope_statement: This candidate concerns only the passive effective mechanics of the normalized scalar memory center. It neither claims nor authorizes S1 topology, phase, winding, or an internal oscillator.

candidate_claim: In the registered local matched-alpha regime of canonical scalar memory, the normalized finite-H memory center c is a positive passive effective-inertial output under the explicitly mathematical port (f, dc/dt). Physical work conjugacy, SI calibration, material mass scaling, and additive momentum remain unclaimed pending A, B, C, E, and F1.

seed_generation_rule.rule: Use the next five positive integer formation seeds after the discovery range 1 through 20 and the next YYYYMMDD integer after the 20260817 center run for response and MSD noise; do not replace failed seeds.

forcing_and_external_system.center_run: Mirrored weak resolved rectangular inputs were added to the x update along coordinate e1; c was the candidate output and both f dx and f dc ledgers were inspected.
forcing_and_external_system.continuum_runs: Mirrored visible-coordinate offsets and force-off controls were used to establish the matched local scalar-memory regime.
forcing_and_external_system.visible_port_run: A native one-step input added to x tested the visible output x and rejected a global positive-mass interpretation of that readout.

visible and center displacement and velocity responses

parameter_cells_or_optimizers_inspected.optimizer: No optimizer or candidate parameter search was used; fixed registered ladders were inspected.

run_lengths_and_cadence.native_cadence: Every update was retained for force-response and work diagnostics.

discovery_provenance.selection_rule: After the visible x-port failed, algebraic elimination of the already-defined normalized memory centroid selected c, with r=x-c as its candidate velocity. The center protocol was committed before seeds 16 through 20 were run. Those results and every earlier scalar continuum and visible-port result are now discovery evidence only. The later affine-readout uniqueness observation was post hoc and did not select this candidate.
